items.title: Leaden, stale, disheartening - where do Celtic & O'Neill go from here?
items.summary: After another defeat, keeping the faith is surely becoming more testing for Celtic's fans, writes Tom English.

items.title: From -17 points to dream European start for Bournemouth
items.summary: Bournemouth started a League Two season on -17 points in 2008, now they have made a dream start in European competition.
